name: Components (Root, Core, UI)

files_processed.purpose: Provides the main top navigation bar and mobile bottom navigation for the application, handling user authentication state and role-based routing.
Unit tests for the Navbar component ensuring responsive design, role-based rendering, and authentication integration.
Provides a reusable Avatar component with image, fallback, badge, and group layout capabilities.
Provides a customizable Badge component for status indicators, tags, and labels with multiple style variants.
Provides a highly customizable Button component with multiple variants, sizes, and states.
Provides layout components for Cards, including Header, Title, Description, Content, Action, and Footer elements.
Provides an accessible modal Dialog component based on Radix UI, including overlays, triggers, and content layouts.
Provides an accessible, responsive Drawer component using Vaul with customizable triggers and content areas.
Provides customizable Dropdown Menu components including triggers, contents, items, checkboxes, and radio groups.
Displays an auto-dismissible floating error banner for global application notifications.
Provides a standard, styled Input component with support for all native HTML input attributes.
Provides an accessible Label component built on top of Radix UI to associate with form controls.
Provides a progress bar component built on Radix UI to visually display task completion.
Provides resizable layout panels and draggable handles using react-resizable-panels.
Provides an accessible dropdown select component based on Radix UI, complete with groups, triggers, items, and scroll buttons.
Provides a standard semantic separator or divider built on Radix UI.
Provides loading placeholder components (skeletons) to indicate that content is loading, including specific variants for various app sections.
Provides an accessible range slider component based on Radix UI.
Provides an accessible toggle switch component based on Radix UI.
Provides accessible tabbed navigation components (List, Trigger, Content) based on Radix UI.
Provides a standard styled textarea component for multiline text input.
Configures and exports a global Toaster component utilizing Sonner for displaying toast notifications.
Provides an accessible tooltip component based on Radix UI to show contextual information on hover or focus.

section_summary: This section encompasses the core structural components and reusable UI elements of the application. It includes the main layout components like the Navbar, along with a comprehensive suite of accessible, customizable primitive UI components built on top of Radix UI and Tailwind CSS to ensure a consistent design system.
